notes.title: About the Latest Developments
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello everyone,[/b][/p][p]Dear Harbor community, we’ve been silent for a while, but it’s time to slowly break that silence.[/p][p]We have temporarily taken down the demo version of the game.
Later on, a portion of the Early Access version will be released again as a [b]Prologue[/b].[/p][p]During our preparations for Early Access, all updated content will be available on our completely revamped [b]Steam store page[/b].[/p][p]We’ll be making frequent announcements about upcoming updates, including new gameplay features, mechanics, regions, and fresh content that will reshape the game’s flow.[/p][p]Let’s take a quick look at what’s coming:[/p][olist][*][p]A brand new [b]construction system[/b] that allows for player-friendly, fast structure building.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Three-tier material upgrades[/b] to enhance the durability of your structures.[/p][/*][*][p]The old wood-stone gathering system is being removed.
It’s being replaced with a new system based on [b]rusty metal and alloy components[/b], which can be refined and transformed.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Enhanced sound detection effects[/b] for enemy gunshots and footsteps at both close and long range, now supported by a [b]3D audio indicator[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updates and improvements to the [b]weapon system[/b], including animations, mechanics, and camera effects.[/p][/*][*][p]For a more enjoyable crafting experience, [b]brand-new workbenches and lootboxes[/b] are being introduced.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New character types (Male / Female)[/b] and [b]new outfit customization options[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]An all-new map set in a [b]chaotic desert environment[/b] where you’ll feel the heat and tension of the wasteland.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Be sure to join our Discord community to stay up to date with all these exciting changes and more![/p]

notes.title: Harbor Gyroscopter UPDATE !
notes.content:
Don’t be misled by the term “helicopter” — it’s actually a gyrocopter. We’re continuing to fix vehicle-related bugs and pushing updates for new vehicle mechanics.

For now, the gyrocopter we've released is available for solo use only, but we’re actively working on expanded variations.

Enjoy your flight!

*Page Notes 3.7

*New Gyroscopter.. (It can be used for single use) 
* Fixed passenger snapping bug in cars.
* Fixed an issue where vehicles would rotate unexpectedly when entering.
* Fixed a bug where players could spawn inside a house after exiting a vehicle.
* Fixed a crouching bug.
* Fixed an issue where audio wouldn’t load after rejoining the game.
* Reworked intro videos.
* You can now get a helicopter from the Butcher NPC in the Harbor area by trading 50 lead bars, 50 oil, and 50 water.
  Note: Once the helicopter spawns, other players can steal it — stay sharp!

notes.title: HARBOR DEMO UPDATE 1.5
notes.content:
We are aware that some of you have experienced server issues due to the recent high volume of traffic. Our team has been working around the clock to address these problems, and we're pleased to announce that we have largely resolved the server issues.
We have increased our server capacity, fixed connection problems, and implemented performance optimizations. Thanks to these improvements, we can now offer a more stable gaming experience.
We would like to thank all our players for your patience and understanding. We will continue working to improve your gaming experience.
If you encounter any issues, please don't hesitate to contact our support team.
Thank you for your interest in our game![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45406295/880658ddda2d357b373546657519220e077965f0.png[/img]

notes.title: Harbor Steam Fest Announcement !!!
notes.content:
Harbor will be available to you on February 24th with Demo.

Hello Everyone,

We're bringing a fresh new take to open-world competitive games!

We've built this crazy world, and we're beyond excited to share it with you. We're just getting started, and to kick things off, we've decided to offer a demo version during the Steam Festival.

You'll be able to experience our demo for free until March 28th!

Your feedback will help us continue building and improving the game. We're fully committed to developing and updating it continuously. We've set sail on a long-term adventure through this sandstorm!

Stay tuned and join our Discord server! Get the latest updates first and connect with us directly. Let’s chat in real-time and be in close contact throughout the development process!

This game is developed by just two dedicated developers.
 We’ve poured our time, energy, and love into crafting this experience, and while we strive for the best, 
there may be rough edges here and there. 
Your patience, feedback and support are as valuable to us as the Mad Max universe.

Thank you for being part of this journey.
